intendedAudience: Middle-aged and older men and women living with diabetes who require protein intake.

directions.name: Sage pouch
directions.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create ONE photorealistic retail-packaging concept image, portrait 2:3, one complete package only. This is alternative 02 for TRAYN Nutrition: a protein product being developed for middle-aged and older men and women living with diabetes. Convey calm adult nutrition through clear hierarchy, strong text contrast and mature gender-neutral design.
Input image 1 is a BRAND IDENTITY REFERENCE: preserve the distinctive TRAYN symbol and TRAYN NUTRITION wordmark shapes shown on the ivory-and-green pouch. It is not a layout to reproduce. Reproduce the identity accurately in flat ink, with no invented replacement logo.
Keep the working name EVERYDAY PROTEIN for comparison; a final name is undecided.
Exact front label text, with strong reading hierarchy: "TRAYN" / "NUTRITION", "EVERYDAY" / "PROTEIN", "Everyday nutrition", "BELGIAN CHOCOLATE", "500 g", "Contains Milk", and small "PACKAGING CONCEPT — NOT FOR SALE". Print all copy on the package, no text floating outside it. Text must be spelled accurately and large enough to read. The old formula/flavor/size are visual exploration placeholders, not a finalized diabetes formulation.
Do not add diabetes suitability statements, blood glucose promises, sugar claims, low-GI claims, clinical claims, protein gram numbers, certification badges, regulatory symbols, nutrition tables, doctors or medical icons. Avoid bodybuilders, people, gym aesthetics and elderly stereotypes.
Single hero product on a seamless warm off-white studio background with soft grounded shadow and premium believable commercial photography. Entire package in frame with 10% breathing room, front readable at a subtle 8-degree turn. No poster, comparison board, collage or extra packages.
DIRECTION A — WARM BOTANICAL MINIMALISM, WITHOUT LEAVES: a soft matte ivory resealable stand-up pouch. Forest-green ink, muted sage and a restrained cocoa-brown flavor detail. Wide generous upper whitespace around the preserved TRAYN logo; large humanist sans-serif EVERYDAY PROTEIN. A single large asymmetrical sage arc across the lower third, not layered racing ribbons. Small finely drawn cocoa-pod illustration adjacent to the chocolate flavor label. Dark forest-green lower edge with large white 500 g and Contains Milk. Sophisticated subtle paper-like pouch texture and real flexible folds. Balanced, reassuring, contemporary daily nutrition.
